::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 11th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 75
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

You were so kind as to say you would let me have an advance on account. I should be very glad if you would send me a [cheque for £150](organizations/other_160.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge
